scenarios.title: A small digital service pilot
scenarios.brief: A fictional student team considers offering a setup service to community organisers. They have no verified demand data and limited weekly capacity.
deliverables: customer evidence plan and bounded offer
two-week work breakdown and dependency map
constraints: no real payments or credential collection
do not promise outcomes outside team control
scenarios.success: The team states what remains unknown and chooses a reversible pilot rather than claiming a validated business.

scenarios.title: School event under a fixed deadline
scenarios.brief: A school group must organise a small event with a fixed opening date, limited budget and changing attendance estimates.
constraints: adult approval for venue, money and safety
no publication of student personal data
scenarios.success: The plan is feasible, safe, auditable and updated transparently when assumptions change.

scenarios.title: Recovering from a process failure
scenarios.brief: A team accidentally overwrites a shared draft and cannot tell which version is current.
constraints: do not reproduce the destructive action
do not blame individuals before facts are established
scenarios.success: Recovery is verified, access is reviewed and the process is improved with reversible controls.

grading: Score evidence quality, domain reasoning, cross-domain integration, safety and reflection separately. A scenario score does not automatically grant discipline mastery.
